venerable-land-raider.name: Venerable Land Raider
venerable-land-raider.transport: This unit can transport up to 5 friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY models.

coronus-grav-carrier.name: Coronus Grav-carrier
coronus-grav-carrier.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY models.

orion-assault-dropship.name: Orion Assault Dropship
orion-assault-dropship.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY models, or up to 7 friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY models and 1 friendly CONTEMPTOR-ACHILLUS DREADNOUGHT, CONTEMPTOR-GALATUS DREADNOUGHT or VENERABLE CONTEMPTOR DREADNOUGHT model.

legendary-commander.name: Legendary Commander
legendary-commander.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

moment-shackle.name: Moment Shackle
moment-shackle.text: If this unit is a WARLORD, and is on the battlefield at the start of the Generate Command Assets step, you generate one extra Command Asset.

custodes-vexilla.name: Custodes Vexilla
custodes-vexilla.text: You can re-roll Morale tests for friendly LIGHT IMPERIUM units whilst they are within 6" of this unit. In addition, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly LIGHT ADEPTUS CUSTODES units whilst they are making Fight actions whilst within 6" of this unit.

slayers-of-tyrants.name: Slayers of Tyrants
slayers-of-tyrants.text: You can re-roll wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by this unit that target CHARACTER units.

hover-jet.name: Hover Jet
hover-jet.text: At the start of the Action phase, you can declare that this unit will hover. If it does, then until the end of the phase, its Move characteristic changes to 20" but it loses the Supersonic ability.

the-emperors-chosen.name: The Emperor's Chosen
the-emperors-chosen.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES units in this Detachment do not suffer penalties for being critically damaged (p33).

inspirational-fighter.name: Inspirational Fighter
inspirational-fighter.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.
